card.name: Image size and reconstruction settings
card.fires_on: Words and spaces just before image matrix or pixel numbers, mainly in PET/SPECT imaging instructions (reconstruction, matrix size, pixel size). Also fires on digits in numbers like gigapixels.

modes.label: Scan reconstruction wording
modes.description: Linking words inside instructions on how to reconstruct or size nuclear medicine images.
modes.example: Image reconstruction should<< include>> attenuation correction with resulting transaxial pixel

modes.label: Space before matrix size
modes.description: The gap right before a matrix dimension such as 128×128.
modes.example: The recommended matrix for planar images is<< >>128×128.

modes.label: Digits in pixel counts
modes.description: A digit inside a large resolution or pixel number in camera text.
modes.example: So what could you do with <<5>>0 gigapixels?

card.writes: It lowers the odds of the word compression and related terms, steering away from image-compression talk.
